captions.detailed: A classic, upright reel-style slot machine cabinet finished in dark red. It features a curved top box profile, a protruding golden central reel window, and a lower service door. A black pull handle with a spherical knob is mounted on its right side, rotating around a cylindrical pivot.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a tall reel-style slot machine with a curved top cabinet, a golden central reel window, and a lower service door. Include a side-mounted pull handle that rotates on a horizontal axis, and a lower door that opens on a vertical side hinge.
captions.factory: The code constructs a main cabinet body by combining box shapes with a curved top profile. It adds a separate gold-colored box for the central reel window and a lower box representing the service door. The pull handle assembly is built using a cylinder for the pivot, a thin rectangular box for the arm, and a sphere for the handle knob, connected to the cabinet via a revolute joint.
